newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes at 11-month high.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes at 11-month high.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 2.7 higher at 992.25, its highest close since December 28, when it was trading at 991 to the dollar, interbank dealers said.

The close was just 1.51 pesos away from the top of the central bank's daily floating rate exchange band, and dealers said the bank was widely expected to intervene aggresively by buying dollars if it breeched the band later this week.
This, in turn, could help cap the peso's strong gains since June, when it was trading at more than 1,070.00 to the dollar, dealers said.

Dealers, who attributed Tuesday's rise in the peso to dollar sales by coffee exporters, reported 268 trades for a total of $103 million. They said the peso hit an intra-day low of 994.55 before heading higher ahead of the close.
